title: Horoscope vs Birth chart
caption:
horoscope vs birth chart: what's the difference? 🌙
A horoscope is a forecast. A birth chart is a map.
cta:
send this to someone who only knows their sun sign 👀
your full chart is free on align, link in bio

ask: Ten seconds, and you'll read your chart better.
explainA: A *horoscope* is written for your sun sign.
You share it with one in twelve people.
explainB: A *birth chart* is the whole sky
at your exact minute and place.
